notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas and Bloom Tender do not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm twice, untapping Walking Atlas and Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{R}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
